interpreter.context: fresh session, no prior knowledge; only the contact sheet and facts were used

object.short_description: Square stepped pyramid built from studded box-shaped bricks, light grey/white with a dark cross-shaped band of stairs on all four sides and a small dark capstone with a window-like opening on top.
object.construction_material: plastic building bricks (inferred from studs and brick-shaped blocks)

estimated_real_size.basis: bounding box is 0.0959 x 0.0959 x 0.0715 file units (glTF metres); the footprint appears to be about 12 studs wide, which is consistent with typical brick pitch of 8 mm. This is an estimate for the toy model, not for any real monument.

structure.overall_shape: square stepped taper with a cross-shaped dark stair band and a small top shrine

components.name: stepped body
components.description: light grey/white terraced levels with studs on upward faces, receding towards the top

components.name: stair arms
components.description: dark bricks forming a central band from base to top on each of the four sides, seen as a cross in the top view, with stepped dark flanks

components.name: top shrine or capstone
components.description: small dark structure at the apex with a lighter opening (window-like gap) beneath a dark roof brick

components.name: dark side steps
components.description: dark bricks stepping outwards along the sides of the lower tiers, forming a stair-like diagonal profile

defects: thin diagonal lines on light faces suggest triangulation seams or coplanar faces
many connected components (435) because bricks are separate bodies

evidence.statement: All four side views show a symmetric terraced pyramid silhouette with receding levels.
Round studs are visible on the upward faces of the light bricks, and the surfaces are made of rectangular brick shapes.
A dark band runs from base to top on each side; the top view shows a dark cross on a light square.
A small dark capstone with a lighter gap sits at the apex, resembling a temple or shrine.
Facts report a stepped_taper footprint profile, 10 horizontal surface levels, high mirror symmetry in a and b, and 435 connected components.
A periodic stud pattern with a pitch of about 5.5 % of the extent was detected, and the model is watertight with 0 boundary edges.
Colours are only dark grey (about 59 %) and off-white (about 41 %), with low saturation.
The views show no distinguishing inscriptions, figures or details that tie the model to one specific real monument.

hypotheses.label: Brick-built toy model of a stepped pyramid with a temple on top
Mesoamerican-style temple pyramid (for example Maya or Aztec) in brick form
Free design without a specific real-world model
Black-and-white themed model of a stepped pyramid with stairs, such as a Mesopotamian ziggurat

questions_for_owner: Is the model based on a particular real pyramid or temple, and where is it?
Is it an official brick set, a custom design or a digital-only construction?
What is the real size of the model, and what is the stud pitch?
Why are the stairs and the capstone dark and the body light, and does the colouring have a meaning?
notes: Axes in the views use z as up, while the file uses y up. Hypotheses overlap and need not sum to 1. The level count of 9 is a visual estimate; the facts list 10 horizontal surface levels.
